title: Cảm ơn, tôi hiểu rồi
summary: A clean way to end a directions explanation once it makes sense.

sections.title: At a glance
sections.body: Cảm ơn, tôi hiểu rồi tells the helper that the directions finally make sense and you are ready to move. It is useful after someone repeats a route, points on a map, writes an address, or explains a stop.

sections.title: The standard way
sections.body: Say this when you want to thank the person and close the explanation kindly.

sections.title: Break it down
sections.body: The sentence combines gratitude with a clear status update.

sections.title: If you still need help
sections.body: Use these before closing the exchange if the route is not clear yet.

phrases.vietnamese: Cho hỏi, đi tới đó thế nào?
phrases.english: Excuse me, how do I get there?
phrases.pronunciation: cho hoy dee toy doh theh nao

phrases.vietnamese: Chỉ trên bản đồ giúp tôi được không?
phrases.english: Can you show me on the map?
phrases.pronunciation: chee tren ban do zoop toy duoc khong

sections.title: When to use it
sections.body: Use it after you understand the turn, stop, pickup point, counter, or walking route. It is especially helpful when the other person has spent time explaining.

sections.title: Good to know
sections.body: This phrase closes the loop. Say it only when you really are ready; if not, ask for a repeat or a map gesture first.

sections.title: Explore next
sections.body: These help before and after the directions moment.
